primary_scope: Rosenthal punctuation §§30–46 excluding already-owned §36 and §44 branches as normalized below
current_norm_gate: Full Academic Guide under V. V. Lopatin §§112–130 and §87 for semantically integral expressions
normalization_rule: A complex-sentence engine owns its normal sign plus structural exceptions that are inseparable from the same parse. Old high-risk cards are retained physically as provenance/routes but are semantically absorbed when the full parent now owns the decision.

P13_ssp_comma.canonical_label: ССП: запятая между предикативными частями и нормативные условия её отсутствия
branches: comma between coordinated predicative parts under connecting/adversative/disjunctive/joining/explanatory relations
no comma with a genuine common secondary member, common subordinate clause, common introductory/detached component or other source-established structural commonality
no comma in source-established interrogative/exclamatory/imperative or structurally homogeneous special configurations
distinguish a single conjunction joining homogeneous members from the same conjunction joining predicative clauses
P13_ssp_comma.cross_owner: The homogeneous-member half of school-single-i-homogeneous-vs-clause-boundary is now owned by school-homogeneous-single-conjunction-punctuation-base from file 256; the clause half is owned here. The historical cross-boundary record therefore has no independent semantic count.

P14_ssp_semicolon.canonical_label: ССП: точка с запятой между распространёнными или относительно самостоятельными частями
P14_ssp_semicolon.current_norm: Current academic SSP semicolon rule; choose semicolon when clause complexity/independence requires a stronger enumerative boundary than comma without turning the parts into separate sentences.

P15_ssp_dash.canonical_label: ССП: тире при резком результате, противопоставлении, быстром следовании или структурно-интонационном переломе
P15_ssp_dash.decision_model: Do not choose dash merely because a coordinating conjunction is present; parse the semantic relation and intonational break between predicative parts.

P16_spp_base.canonical_label: СПП: отделение придаточной части от главной запятой
branches: subordinate after main clause
subordinate before main clause
subordinate inserted inside main clause and isolated on both sides
source-established cases where a surface conjunction/relative word does not introduce a full subordinate clause and therefore does not trigger the ordinary comma
P16_spp_base.ownership_boundary: Classification of союз vs союзное слово remains owned by school-subordinator-vs-relative-word-what-when-how; this unit owns punctuation after the syntactic status is established.

P17_complex_subordinator.canonical_label: СПП со сложным подчинительным союзом: союз целиком или расчленён, место запятой
branches: whole conjunction enters subordinate clause and comma precedes its first component
conjunction is split and comma falls inside the conjunction under semantic/intonational/contextual conditions
current non-splitting patterns and obligatory/strongly preferred boundaries
particles/intensifiers before a simple subordinate conjunction move the comma before the intensifier where the current rule requires
P17_complex_subordinator.cross_link: Orthographic spelling of conjunctions remains owned by school-conjunction-solid-separate-spelling-base; this unit owns punctuation/segmentation in the sentence.

P18_multiple_subordinates.canonical_label: СПП с несколькими придаточными: однородное, неоднородное и последовательное подчинение; стык союзов
branches: homogeneous subordinate clauses punctuated by homogeneous-member principles
sequential subordination with separation of subordinate parts
several main parts with one common subordinate part
junction of two subordinate conjunctions or coordinating+subordinating conjunctions
presence/absence of a correlating ТО/ТАК or other second component controls whether the conjunction junction is split

P19_spp_special_signs.canonical_label: СПП: специальные знаки вместо базовой запятой или в дополнение к ней
P19_spp_special_signs.current_norm: Lopatin §§124–126 and current multi-part sentence rules
branches: semicolon between sufficiently independent/extended subordinate blocks where a stronger boundary is warranted
dash between subordinate and main parts for emphatic, interrogative, parallel, generalizing or clarifying structure
colon before a subordinate part when the main part contains a warning/predictive component or the subordinate expresses an indirect question/explanation under the current rule
comma+dash in source-established period/structural combinations; do not treat the pair as decorative
P19_spp_special_signs.counting_policy: One structured non-basic-sign family. The signs are branches chosen after the SPP structure is parsed, not four unrelated denominator parents.

P20_integral_expressions.canonical_label: Цельное по смыслу сочетание с союзным/местоименным словом или обычная придаточная конструкция
branches: lexicalized/semantically integral combinations such as как следует, во что бы то ни стало, кто во что горазд and analogous source/current constructions without internal comma
particle constructions such as не то чтобы, не иначе как in their integral use
pronominal/adverbial combinations типа неизвестно кто/где in integral use
same surface sequence becomes a genuine subordinate clause in a different syntax and is then punctuated by the ordinary SPP rule
P20_integral_expressions.cross_link: Fixed NI spelling inside members such as во что бы то ни стало remains orthographically owned by school-ni-fixed-idioms; this identity owns the comma/no-comma syntactic boundary.

P21_bsp_comma_semicolon.canonical_label: БСП при перечислении: запятая или точка с запятой по тесноте связи и распространённости частей
branches: comma between closely related enumerative parts
semicolon between more independent or internally complicated parts
internal complexity of each part does not remove the BSP relation

P22_bsp_dash.canonical_label: БСП: тире по смысловым отношениям между частями
branches: contrast/comparison
result/consequence or rapid event transition
conditional/temporal relation in source-established structures
comparison and other current semantic branches
P22_bsp_dash.ownership_boundary: school-colon-bsp-vs-generalizing-word remains independent because it owns the colon-vs-simple-sentence classification and Rosenthal §44/current §129 explanatory/causal relations.

P23_bsp_comma_dash.canonical_label: БСП: запятая и тире в специальных структурно-смысловых конфигурациях
P23_bsp_comma_dash.learner_policy: Do not treat comma+dash as a generic stronger dash. Establish the syntactic closure/completion requiring the comma and the independent semantic/intonational boundary requiring the dash.
